digest.component_or_area: MCP client credential wiring and diagnostics
key_entities: omitting MCP server without an exact ready client
propositions: Codex MCP initialization silently omits the rebar server when the configured bearer_token_env_var names an unset or incorrectly-named environment variable, with no actionable diagnostic.
The documented credential setup prescribes a transient shell export that does not persist across new shell sessions, leaving the variable absent when codex runs in a fresh terminal.
The local config names REBAR_CODEX_PAT, a variable that does not appear in the committed repository; the canonical name is MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX, defined in docs and examples.
Missing or misnamed credentials must be detected by a dedicated preflight scanner that reports the unresolved variable name and the canonical remediation without printing the secret.
Regression coverage via automated tests must enforce consistency between the canonical credential name, committed documentation, example configs, and the MCP client config contracts.
